facts.about: Incorporated in 2008, Kaynes Technology is a leading end-to-end and IoT solutions-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing company. The company provides conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support for major players in the automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense, outer-space, nuclear, medical, railways, Internet of Things ("IoT"), Information Technology ("IT") and other segments.

flags.text: Operating leverage: profit +56%/yr vs sales +48%/yr over 3 years
Operating cash flow was negative over 5 years (₹-615 cr) despite ₹977 cr of profit
Receivable days stretched from 74 to 154 in 3 years

business.summary: Kaynes Technology is an integrated ESDM enterprise providing design, manufacturing, and lifecycle support for complex electronic systems. It serves sectors like aerospace, defence, automotive, and EVs, generating revenue through product sales and engineering services.

segments.name: Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS)
segments.note: The company operates predominantly in this single business segment.

guidance.statement: We are quite confident of achieving the twice the market growth.
guidance.quote: So we don't want to commit on the top-line number, but whatever the market growth is there, because of the strategic initiatives of keeping the inventory, keeping the manufacturing flexible, and having a very committed people, we are quite confident of achieving the twice the market growth.

guidance.statement: We are targeting INR450 to INR500 crores for OSAT and PCB combined.
guidance.quote: As far as OSAT and PCB is concerned, we already told from third quarter the revenue starts in both the business, and we have committed a full year revenue of totally INR500 crores between both, INR450 to INR500 crores, which is what we are targeting at this point in time, we are on the target.

guidance.statement: We will turn cash positive by the end of the financial year.
guidance.quote: which gives us the confidence that whatever the commitment that we have given to you as a leadership team, that by end of the financial year we'll turn the cash positive, we are pretty confident on that.

guidance.statement: We will outgrow the market and we will be doubling the market growth.
guidance.quote: That is one of the reasons that why we chose to say this time that we'll be outgrowing the market and we'll be doubling the market growth, so that our penetration is much more.

guidance.statement: We will do a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores.
guidance.quote: I'm sure and certain we will do a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores, and OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.

guidance.statement: We will do OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.
guidance.quote: I'm sure and certain we will do a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores, and OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.

guidance.statement: I am expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25% because of these coming in.
guidance.quote: So rail business, I'm expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25% because of these coming in.

guidance.statement: We are still sticking on to our $1 billion revenue guidance for fiscal '28.
guidance.quote: See, on the growth, what we have projected $1 billion, we are still sticking on to that

guidance.statement: We expect net working capital to be between 70 to 85 days by March '26.
guidance.quote: So typically, what we expect is about between 70 to 85 days. Last year, it was 85 days.

guidance.statement: We expect at least INR1,500 crores revenue from our OSAT business.
guidance.quote: So, at the minimum, you can expect INR1,500 crores from our OSAT business.

guidance.statement: We expect about INR1,000 crores revenue from our PC Board business.
guidance.quote: Similarly, you can expect about INR1,000 crores from PC Board business.

guidance.statement: We will be operating cash flow positive at the consolidated level by the end of this year.
guidance.quote: So going forward, at consol level, we'll definitely be OCF positive by end of this year.

guidance.statement: The company expects to maintain strong growth rates in EMS verticals over the next few years.
guidance.quote: If you take last several 4 years CAGR, the next few years CAGR also will be thereabouts.

guidance.statement: The company plans to fund OSAT and PCB capex through QIP, internal accruals, and debt.
guidance.quote: Balance requirement for OSAT INR10.3 billion will be funded through QIP and spent amount of about 3.8 billion and balance internal accruals capex spread over five years and some transitory debt.

scorecard.promised: Achieve twice the market growth and maintain strong historical CAGR rates.
scorecard.delivered: Revenue grew 40.6% YoY in Jun 2026, down from 69.7% in Jun 2024.
scorecard.evidence: Annual revenue grew 33% in FY26 (₹3,626cr) vs 51% in FY25 (₹2,722cr), showing a decelerating trend.

scorecard.promised: Turn cash positive by end of FY26 and maintain positive OCF at consolidated level.
scorecard.delivered: Operating cash flow was negative ₹600 cr for the year ending March 2026.
scorecard.evidence: CFO worsened from -₹82 cr in FY25 to -₹600 cr in FY26 despite ₹364 cr PAT.

scorecard.promised: Expect net working capital to be between 70 to 85 days by March 2026.
scorecard.delivered: Cash conversion cycle reached 193 days by March 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Debtor days alone stand at 154 days, far exceeding the total working capital target of 85 days.

scorecard.promised: Targeting ₹450-₹500 crores combined revenue for FY27; production starting Q2 FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Commercial production for PCB set to start next quarter; OSAT samples shipped.
scorecard.evidence: Capital work in progress stands at ₹511 cr as of March 2026 to support these targets.

scorecard.promised: Sticking to $1 billion revenue guidance for fiscal 2028.
scorecard.evidence: Requires ~33% CAGR over next two years to hit ~$1bn (₹8,300cr+) target.

narrative.scoreline: Management consistently delivers strong top-line growth but has failed significantly on cash flow and working capital promises.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: We consciously degrew smart metering to prioritize collections and balance sheet health.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Receivable days stretched from 74 to 154 days in 3 years; CFO hit record negative ₹600cr.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Commercial production for PCB is on track to start from the next quarter (Q2 FY27).
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: CWIP of ₹511 cr confirms significant ongoing investment in new manufacturing capacity.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Inventory was increased to mitigate supply chain volatility and ensure 40%+ growth.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Jun 2026 revenue grew 40.6% YoY, aligning with the stated growth trade-off.

bull: Strong revenue scaling from ₹1,126 cr in FY23 to ₹3,626 cr in FY26.
Operating leverage is evident with profit growing 56% vs sales 48% over three years.
Diversification into high-value OSAT and PCB sectors is backed by ₹511 cr in CWIP.
bear: Severe cash flow issues with cumulative 5-year OCF at negative ₹615 cr despite ₹977 cr profit.
Working capital cycle of 193 days is more than double the management's 85-day target.
High customer concentration with one client accounting for 23.99% of total sale of goods.
watch: First revenue contribution from PCB and OSAT units in Q2/Q3 FY27 results.
Reduction in debtor days from current 154-day peak toward 85-day target.
Quarterly CFO trend to verify 'cash positive' FY27 year-end guidance.

claims.claim: We consciously degrew in smart metering to prioritize collections and improve balance sheet health.
claims.quote: we have taken a conscious decision of growing more in EMS business, which is our traditional and core business, and we have degrown in the smart metering business

claims.claim: We increased inventory to mitigate global supply chain volatility and ensure business continuity.
claims.quote: Just because our team has added upon the inventory there, we could able to successfully grow at 40% of plus as an overall, and EMS business alone about 48%.

claims.claim: Commercial production for PCB is on track to start from the next quarter.
claims.quote: This is the time, I think Kaynes is entering into this, and our commercial production is set to start from the next quarter, and our team is doing the last-minute finishing of the capital

claims.claim: Near-term revenue missed expectations due to geopolitical disruption, customer deferments, and supply chain delays.
claims.quote: Near-term top line performance did not fully meet market expectations, primarily due to geopolitical disruption, especially the West Asia conflict, which led to last-minute customer deferment, supply chain delays and product timing shift.

claims.claim: The company expects to reverse the trend in metering business working capital within three quarters.
claims.quote: Rest assured, ladies and gentlemen, we'll be able to bring it back at least to a level of reduction. I think the inflection point has stopped and will come into the reduction.

claims.claim: The company is transitioning from a traditional EMS-led organization to a differentiated ESDM and product-driven enterprise.
claims.quote: One of our key strategic priorities in the next few years will be to accelerate the transition from a traditional EMS-led organization to a differentiated ESDM and product-driven enterprise.

claims.claim: Our order book is not cancellable and represents approximately 1.5 years of revenue.
claims.quote: If you look at it, our order books are not cancellable. These order books, we have lead times, but customers don't take our products unless their entire project is aligned.

claims.claim: The Kavach order was deferred to ensure we supply the next revision for better field performance.
claims.quote: At this point in time, it happens to be Kavach because it's a safety critical item, and we have just made sure that the design that we put out doesn't need to have any upgrades.

claims.claim: We are shifting away from the AMISP business model to focus on device manufacturing.
claims.quote: We are only saying that we will be away from the AMISP business. But meter as a product, which we were doing it for the last 5, 6 years, we are continuing to do.

claims.claim: The company maintains strong ethics and there are no governance concerns or underlying deterioration in business.
claims.quote: Let me reiterate this firmly that there are no governance concerns and no underlying deterioration in business.

claims.claim: The acquisition was a strategic bilateral deal at an attractive price due to the erstwhile parent's exit.
claims.quote: Kaynes had always been a supplier partner since Iskraemeco's India entity, and hence Kaynes was able to strike a bilateral deal and negotiated the same at an attractive price.

claims.claim: Working capital intensity is typical for the EMS industry and normalization measures are underway.
claims.quote: Firstly, the working capital intensity is typical to the EMS industry and multiple initiatives are underway to improve it

claims.claim: Commercial production has started with sample shipments to three major clients.
claims.quote: So, the samples have been shipped out, so in some sense, technically, the commercial production has started.

risks.text: Contingent liabilities include income tax, indirect tax, bank guarantees, and corporate guarantees to subsidiaries.
Revenue recognition is a key audit matter due to cut-off risk and variable consideration estimates.
Reliance on a customised ERP system for financial reporting processes and automated controls.
Concentration risk exists as Customer A accounts for 23.99% of sale of goods revenue.
